boundary: This ledger records bounded workflow evidence. Same-owner validation is not independent reproduction and does not establish scientific, legal, cultural, identity, production, security, accessibility, deployment, or Stage 20 claims.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Split independent surfaces, use cheap ref checks before clean-state checks, and give each attributable command one adequate bounded envelope.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Never aggregate a long Git status or remote query with task-list and version operations whose results would be lost together.
preferred_methods.rollback: Give each timed-out wrapper zero evidence credit and inspect state before issuing a narrower probe.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Read-only workflow recovery only; no phase, scientific, authority, production, or routing credit beyond the observed probes.
preferred_methods.title: Bounded attributable long-repository probes
trigger_preconditions: A Git, task-title, version, or file probe may take longer than a short composite wrapper.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Preserve submitted assignments, emit the exact issues, generate a sequential candidate from the declared sixteen-seat cycle, and mark ownership changes as requiring confirmation.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Never activate, rename, message, or pre-name a future CLI seat merely to make a schedule fit.
preferred_methods.rollback: Keep the raw failing audit and use the candidate only as advisory teaching material until the live route is confirmed.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Workflow-plan structure only; no future CLI sibling is created, named, activated, or granted authority.
preferred_methods.title: Contradictory route preservation with advisory normalization
trigger_preconditions: A live workflow changes cycle membership or phase ownership and its narrated assignments are not sequential.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Pass one --focus option for each literal fragment.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Inspect repeatable argparse options before using regular-expression syntax.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the zero-scope receipt with zero promotion credit and overwrite only its generated audit directory after recording the failure.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Read-only inventory selection only; no destructive remaster or deprecation.
preferred_methods.title: Repeated literal focus arguments for Reflection-Remaster
trigger_preconditions: The Reflection-Remaster runner must select more than one name fragment.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Add only missing architectural and rollback explanation, then rerun the staged document check.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Measure the overview after final sections are generated and before commit.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the short overview result and remove any filler that does not improve the handoff.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Overview completeness only; word count does not establish scientific or authority quality.
preferred_methods.title: Measured three-page overview completion
trigger_preconditions: The exact staged document review reports an overview below 1,000 words.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Invoke codex through cmd.exe /d /c so Windows resolves the npm command shim correctly.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Use an explicit Windows command interpreter for .cmd or extensionless npm shims inside subprocess validators.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the crashed canonical attempt with zero credit and do not rerun the broad validator until the isolated command succeeds.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: CLI version subprocess only; it does not validate other canonical checks or launch any CLI sibling.
preferred_methods.title: Windows npm shim invocation through cmd.exe
trigger_preconditions: A Python validator must verify a Windows npm-installed CLI version.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Read the sealed truth from the exact base Git object, verify base-to-current ancestry, and run only successor-compatible scoped modules.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Do not execute historical HEAD-count assertions as if an additive successor were still the sealed phase head.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the failed historical assertion and keep the base test byte-stable.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Base continuity only; immutable receipt reading does not replay or expand the sealed canonical suite.
preferred_methods.title: Immutable base-object continuity on additive successor heads
trigger_preconditions: A special continuation validates an already sealed base phase without rewriting its historical tests.
